_readme: Channel table for the value ledger. Copy next to your ledger file and keep it current.
The 'channel' value here is what goes in the channel column of _receipts/ledger.tsv.
monthly_fee is what you actually pay per month; a gifted channel has 0.
Use 'metered' for pay-per-use and 'gifted' for free quota.
Prices and limits change: re-check the source links and move 'checked' forward.
checked = the date someone last read the official page.
'tbd' means we could not verify it on an official page - check it yourself.

fx._note: rates used to convert other currencies into the ledger's unit; update when you re-check

plans.name: OpenCode Go
plans.quota: per model: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash $60 of usage a month; Go Plus is $40/month with $120 for the same model
plans.rate_limits: per model: 5 hours = 20% of the monthly limit, weekly = 50%, monthly = 100%. For DeepSeek V4.1 Flash that is $12 per 5 hours and $30 per week. Roughly 26,000 requests per 5 hours.
plans.reset: rolling; the 5-hour and weekly windows move with use
plans.note: one subscription covers several vendors, useful when you have no other worker CLI

plans.name: DeepSeek official API (pay per use)
plans.billing_cycle: pay per use, prepaid balance; granted balance is spent first
plans.peak_hours: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday (Chinese public holidays are off-peak); off-peak is half price
plans.note: run long jobs off-peak when you can: the same tokens cost half

plans.name: ChatGPT subscription with Codex
plans.quota: shared by Codex and ChatGPT Work; local messages and cloud chats draw on the same allowance, and weekly limits may also apply
plans.rate_limits: message estimates per 5-hour window differ per model; Extra credits can be bought after the limit, or run with an API key at API rates
plans.reset: rolling 5-hour window; check the usage dashboard for the current reset time
plans.tiers: Free $0, Go $8, Plus $20, Pro from $100 (5x or 20x Plus limits), Business $25 per user per month billed monthly
plans.note: tbd in our ledger: which tier a run used - write the tier you actually pay for in monthly_fee

plans.name: Zhipu GLM Coding Plan
plans.billing_cycle: monthly; Lite from $18, Pro and Max are higher (tier fee tbd, verify before you renew)
plans.quota: credits per 5 hours and per week: Lite 2,000 / 10,000, Pro 12,000 / 60,000, Max 28,000 / 140,000; credits for GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash only
plans.rate_limits: concurrency per tier, Max > Pro > Lite; recommended number of parallel projects: Lite 1, Pro 1-2, Max 2+; higher during off-peak
plans.reset: 5-hour credits refresh 5 hours after they are used; weekly credits reset every 7 days from the subscription date
plans.peak_hours: Monday to Friday 14:00-18:00 UTC+8; off-peak bills at 50% of the credit rate
plans.note: only for the supported tools; account sharing or using it in unsupported tools can get the plan restricted

plans.name: Google AI plan with Gemini
plans.billing_cycle: monthly $19.99, annual $199.99; Google AI Ultra is $99.99 a month
plans.quota: higher access to Gemini models than the free tier; no published token number
plans.rate_limits: tier-based, no published numbers; usage is shared across Gemini apps and the API surface you use
plans.note: tbd: which Google AI tier you pay for, and whether your models run inside the plan or through an API key
